BRUTALITY IN PRISONS OUT OF CONTROL

Starke Investigation wrongly limited to Valdes' Death in XWing, Beatings of work camp inmates ignored.

FEDERAL MARIJUANA PRISONER PUT IN ISOLATION IN FLORIDA STATE PRISON FOR "WRITING LETTERS TO MIAMI HERALD."

An obvious attempt by desperate people to hide the truth.

PRISONS ALL OVER AMERICA HIDING ABUSES

Medical abuse should be major concern

August 16, 1999

Kay Lee, aka Grandma Lee will leave Key West on Tuesday, August 17th on a journey for justice to Starke Prison near Gainesville. Ms Lee will make a brief stop in Miami to visit Joe Hart in the Miami VA and plans to be at the prison complex well before the prisoners' families begin to arrive for their once a week visit on Saturday.

Ms Lee is making an effort to keep the investigation going until real changes are made. Her main goal at the prison is to meet other prisoner's families and hear their personal stories. And she wants to see Gary Waid returned to his federal prison in Texarkana.

Ms Lee is making an appeal to Governor Bush to force an investigation of prison practices in all Florida prisons and hopes this will motivate people all over the nation to demand the system make the walls of the prison industrial complex more transparent.

~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~

Starke is under investigation for the beating death of Frank Valdes.

However, all calls to do a through investigation and clean up have been ignored.

Federal marijuana prisoner Gary B. Waid #24582-034 (illegal D.C. #0-124551) has been trying to expose abuses in the Florida State Work Camp in Starke in his letter writing campaign to Florida newspapers.

Last week, without warning, guards removed Mr Waid from his cell and confiscated his writing materials. Major Tyson at the prison replied to Gary's attorney, Don Cohn's (Miami - 305-324-1649) questioning: "He's being held here for writing a letter to the Miami Herald."

Warden Crosby stated in a phone call received approximately 4:15 today (Monday) that the process had been started to return Gary to his cell at the Florida State Work Camp.

Gary Brooks Waid was traded to the state system last year under Executive Order #98-188 signed by Gov. Chiles. Thirty drug offenders, all model prisoners, were sent to Florida with then governor Chiles claiming the deal was to save Florida money.

Mr Waid was sent to Butler first, where he wrote about the deplorable conditions there. Starke lists his initial receipt date as 11-5-98.
(re: Internet Web Site for the Florida D.O.C. http://www.dc.state.fl.us/ActiveInmates )

Mr Cohn was employed to get Waid sent back to the federal prison where he has spent five years of a nine year sentence for conspiracy to import marijuana.

Gary Waid's attorney, Mr Don Cohn (Miami - 305-324-1649) went to the prison to investigate the prison's actions, and was told by Major Tyson that Gary Waid was taken from the work camp to the main Starke prison, all his writing materials were confiscated, and he was being isolated because he "WROTE A LETTER TO THE MIAMI HERALD," an obvious attempt to cover up the truth.

Gary is a first time non-violent federal offender sentenced (with no drugs in evidence) to nine years for conspiracy to import marijuana. He has never had to be punished in his entire 5 years of incarceration.

~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~

Gary tells prison stories from a refreshing new angle. Some of his writing can be seen on his website at

http://www.zyworld.com/kay~lee/garywaid.htm

(All stories are from his first book: "The Dancing Bears: A Smuggler's Tales From Jail. His publisher's rewrite manuscript was 'lost' in the mailroom for months and that is the only reason the book is not yet available.)

~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~
